item.title: Lambda Legal names Douglas F. Curtis as chief legal advocacy officer
item.description: Lambda Legal announced today (Wednesday, Jan. 28) that Douglas Curtis has been named as chief legal advocacy officer for the organization, effective Feb. 9. This makes Curtis the senior-most leader of the Legal Department at Lambda Legal, guiding a team of nearly 50 civil rights attorneys, policy advocates and program staff from multiple practice areas […]
